svg.text: the course of my life, and its ceiling
“if it worked… on second thought, no”
changing my mind about switching majors
no; the past can’t be put right
at sixteen, dating the one I liked
a random event, or an experiment
surprises, and a better rehearsal my life then misses
experiences I treasure, like meeting a friend
whether different choices part ways or meet again
love, and the choices of a life
big choices you can reason through
a future narrowed, or a possibility made a number
anything I go through in love
